review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: Playwright connectOverCDP measurement browsers on macOS die when launched as shell children of a sandboxed agent harness (killed on command exit even with nohup); a persistent chromium.launchServer in a dedicated background shell is the reliable measurement-browser pattern for attended runs.
learnings.evidence: two Chrome respawns died mid-run (ECONNREFUSED); launchServer in a background shell survived all measures

learnings.statement: Planner-authored smoke specs must carry machine-checkable CSS selector asserts, not prose — lint smoke.json asserts the way validateDriveSteps rejects prose drives.
learnings.evidence: smoke failed with CSS parse errors on prose asserts

learnings.statement: Velt SDK demo keys emit Firestore Listen/Write channel 400 console errors independent of customization; smoke specs need allowedConsoleErrorPatterns for firestore.googleapis.com channel noise or R30 false-fails every family.
learnings.evidence: 115 Listen requests on a pre-build page; errors present on default UI
